correctness.rationale: The integral generalized-derangement recurrence is equivalent to a closed formula in ordinary derangements. Both parity-disc falling-factorial interpolation series converge coefficientwise over Z_2 and are calculated modulo eight. Their normalized values have the shapes t+2Q_0(t) and 1+t+2Q_1(t), with integral restricted series Q_i, yielding exact distance preservation for equal-parity indices; opposite parity differences are odd. The two-power bijections, disjoint Legendre obstruction layers and density 1/6 plus logarithmic error follow by rigorous counting. Included checker verifies independent finite instances but is not used as proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general theorem for all positive even parameters would cover this result, but Ulas explicitly leaves that case unresolved. Known all-level classical derangement results concern v=0, and have nonuniform dyadic fibers rather than the bijective fibers for v=2, so cannot be substituted through normalization. A recurrence-identity theorem alone does not imply an exact 2-adic isometry.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new v=2 theorem implies Ulas’s previously obtained 8n+2 obstruction progression but adds all higher valuation strata, upgrades lower density bound 1/8 to exact 1/6, and derives a stronger all-pairs isometry. Ulas’s stated congruences do not logically imply the all-pairs valuation equality. Other inspected identities express sequence terms but do not supply their dyadic index-value metric. This is a positive mathematical implication comparison rather than a title search alone.

originality.rationale: Ulas explicitly sets as open the characterization of three-square obstructions for positive even parameters and whether their density exists (2023 article, Section 4, Problems 4.1 and Question 4.3). For the first unresolved case v=2 the new exact global two-adic isometry determines the full obstruction set and density 1/6. Relevant generalized-derangement combinatorial papers and classical-derangement arithmetic establish different or weaker assertions. Searches found no explicit published theorem implying this statement; possible uninspected equivalents remain a genuine risk.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent valuation/isometry law may be implicit in an uninspected generalized-derangement arithmetic paper or sequence database; limited broad-source inspection cannot exclude this.
The historical 2023 issue could have appeared publicly before the verified September 2024 online date; no exact earliest date for the issue was independently established.
The Ferrari document was only partially accessible and Miska’s 62-page manuscript was inspected selectively rather than end to end; these gaps were not treated as blanket noncoverage.

value.rationale: A 2023 article explicitly asks to characterize three-square obstruction sets at even generalized-derangement parameters and whether their densities exist. At the natural first unresolved even parameter two, the theorem gives an exact index–value isometry at every power of two and a complete obstruction set with sharp density 1/6, strengthening the known 1/8 lower bound and resolving two motivated questions in that case. The structure is not a routine substitution or isolated small-modulus computation.
